public_rationale: The October 22, 2026 report describes Tesla cutting proposed AI spending from $25 billion to $20 billion, without identifying a NVIDIA-specific reduction or isolating its broad-market effect [e1]. Microsoft's April 29, 2026 disclosure describes using its own hardware alongside NVIDIA and AMD hardware, without establishing reduced NVIDIA investment [e2]. The November 25, 2025 report describes Meta considering Google chips; NVIDIA fell 2.6% while the S&P 500 rose 0.9% that day [e3]. These items establish neither a qualifying NVIDIA investment change nor a material broad-market loss attributable to one [e1, e2, e3].
limitations: The evidence does not establish a material NVIDIA-specific reduction or substitution against a prior investment baseline [e1, e2, e3].
The contract interprets “changes” as reductions or substitution, although the literal wording also includes increases.
One day's broad-index gain does not exclude later harm [e3].
“Eventually” supplies no deadline, so a finite period without harm cannot contradict the forecast.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: If any of the five big GPU buyers significantly changes its NVIDIA chip spending, it will eventually hurt the wider market directly and meaningfully.
conditions: if any of the five big buyers significantly changes NVIDIA chip investment

statement.excerpt: In the event that any one of these companies makes significant changes to their investments in NVIDIA chips, it will eventually have a direct and meaningful negative impact on the wider market.
statement.document_title: The Hater's Guide To The AI Bubble

from_speaker: In the event that any one of these companies
makes significant changes to their investments in NVIDIA chips
our_interpretation: The named buyers are Amazon, Alphabet/Google, Microsoft, Meta and Tesla.

In this warning about NVIDIA dependence, read significant changes as material reductions or substitution away from NVIDIA investment. The literal wording also covers increases; that ambiguity is retained.
A qualifying change must occur after the post and concern NVIDIA investment specifically. A total capital-budget revision or discussion of alternative chips alone is insufficient.
A meaningful wider-market effect means a material adverse effect on a broad US equity index attributable to the qualifying change, not merely a fall in NVIDIA or the buyer.
Eventually supplies no deadline or maximum lag.
criteria.support_condition: A documented qualifying NVIDIA investment change occurs and credible dated evidence attributes a material broad-US-equity loss to that change.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After a qualifying change, decisive evidence rules out the claimed eventual direct material adverse effect. A temporary market gain, recovery or finite period without harm is insufficient.

evidence.locator: Satya Nadella's prepared remarks, infrastructure discussion
evidence.explanation: Use of internally designed hardware can coexist with NVIDIA deployment. This statement supplies neither a NVIDIA spending reduction nor a quantified comparison with prior purchases.

evidence.locator: Paragraph following the report about Meta considering Google chips
evidence.explanation: The article describes market concern about possible substitution, rather than a confirmed NVIDIA investment cut. Its account of broad-index gains also cautions against treating a NVIDIA-specific decline as proof of wider-market harm.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Primary records establishing a material NVIDIA-specific investment reduction or substitution by a named buyer, followed by credible causal evidence of a material broad-US-equity loss attributable to it. Contradiction requires a dated event or conclusive causal finding that excludes the eventual effect. Investment increases require separate assessment under the wording's ambiguity.
